The best material is a long, even run of counter-intuitive, testable claims about everyday behaviour — a visible phone lowers measured IQ, scrolling doesn't count as a break, boredom is where ideas come from, stress cycles never closing is what kills — with the most striking science clustered in the middle two hours and the most personal material (her own addiction) at the very end.

The 22-year-old who arrived clinically burned out one quarter into his first job — funny and telling, but it needs the stress-cycle frame from a later stretch to mean anything.
